summaryZh: Molina Lab 研究线粒体功能与衰老和年龄相关疾病的关系。方向包括血细胞生物能标志物、阿尔茨海默病早期生物能特征，以及线粒体质量控制与身体功能下降。
researchQuestions: 线粒体功能与衰老及年龄相关疾病的发生有何关系？

evidence.quote: The Molina Lab focuses on understanding how mitochondrial function is related to aging and the development of age-related diseases.
bioenergetic profiles of blood cells are related to multiple age-related diseases and disorders.
bioenergetic signatures that are associated with presymptomatic stages of AD and are predictive of AD progression.
bioenergetic decline due to alterations in mitochondrial quality control and age-related exercise intolerance.
